* Remove unused max_retries parameter from ConnectionPool

The max_retries parameter was stored but never used - the @retry decorator
hardcodes stop_after_attempt(3). Since we're standardizing on 3 retries
throughout the codebase (as seen in reader.py), removed the unused parameter.

Fixes issue #2737607634 - Medium severity

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Fix test mock paths to use correct import path

The tests were mocking 'app.workflows.lib.changes_inserter.cdc_module' but the actual
import in _get_olap_table() is 'from app.ingest import cdc as cdc_module'.

Fixed by replacing all mock decorators and inline patch statements to use 'app.ingest.cdc'
instead. This ensures tests properly intercept the dynamic import and validate caching
behavior and missing table handling.

Addresses: https://github.com/514-labs/registry/pull/177#discussion_r2737607642

* Remove unreachable RetryError exception handler

The @retry decorator uses reraise=True, which causes the original exception
(dbapi.Error or OSError) to be re-raised after retries are exhausted, not a
RetryError. This makes the except RetryError block unreachable dead code.

Fixed by:
- Removed unreachable except RetryError block from get_connection()
- Removed unused RetryError import
- Updated docstring to document actual exceptions that are raised

The original exceptions provide better debugging information and are already
properly logged by the retry decorator.

Addresses: https://github.com/514-labs/registry/pull/177#discussion_r2737607638

* Fix connection resource leak when abandoning invalid connections

When get_connection() detects an invalid connection or validation fails,
it was setting self._connection to None without first closing the old
connection. This orphans the connection object, leaking database resources
(network sockets, connection slots) until garbage collection runs.

Fixed by:
- Call connection.close() before setting to None when connection is invalid
- Call connection.close() before setting to None when validation fails
- Use try/except for best-effort close (don't fail if close fails)
- Matches the pattern used in the close() method

This prevents resource leaks and ensures connections are properly cleaned up
when they become invalid or fail validation.

Addresses: https://github.com/514-labs/registry/pull/177#discussion_r2737686941

* Fix unreachable circuit breaker half-open failure branch

The elif checking for HALF_OPEN state was unreachable dead code. When the
circuit enters HALF_OPEN state, failure_count is already >= failure_threshold
(that's why it opened). On the next failure, the count is incremented first,
making the threshold check always true before the state check.

Fixed by reording conditions to check state before threshold:
- Check if state == HALF_OPEN first (specific case)
- Then check failure_count >= threshold (general case)

This ensures the "re-opening after failed recovery attempt" log message
appears correctly when a failure occurs during half-open testing.

Addresses: https://github.com/514-labs/registry/pull/177#discussion_r2737686938

* Export ClientTableStatus from package __init__

The conftest.py imports ClientTableStatus but it wasn't exported from
the package __init__.py, causing import errors in CI tests.

Added ClientTableStatus to:
- Import statement from .models
- __all__ export list

This fixes the CI test failure:
ImportError: cannot import name 'ClientTableStatus' from 'sap_hana_cdc'

* Fix test mock to properly simulate missing attribute

The test was using 'del mock_module.missing_table' but MagicMock auto-creates
attributes when accessed via hasattr(), so the test wasn't actually testing
the missing attribute case.

Fixed by using Mock(spec=[]) which creates a mock with no attributes,
ensuring hasattr() returns False for any attribute lookup.

This properly tests that _get_olap_table returns None when a table is not
found in the cdc module.

Addresses: https://github.com/514-labs/registry/pull/177#discussion_r2737766519

* Fix test fixture name from sample_batch_change to sample_batch

Tests were using the wrong fixture name 'sample_batch_change' but the
actual fixture defined in conftest.py is named 'sample_batch'.

This was causing fixture not found errors in CI:
E   fixture 'sample_batch_change' not found

Fixed by renaming all occurrences in:
- tests/test_connector.py (7 occurrences)
- tests/test_reader.py (3 occurrences)

* Fix mock connection type in infrastructure and reader tests

Tests were using mock_connection fixture expecting a MagicMock, but the
fixture returns a MockConnection instance. This caused AttributeErrors:
  AttributeError: 'function' object has no attribute 'return_value'

Fixed by switching to simple_mock_connection fixture which provides
a properly mocked connection with MagicMock behavior.

Changes:
- test_infrastructure.py: Replace all mock_connection with simple_mock_connection
- test_reader.py: Replace all mock_connection with simple_mock_connection

The simple_mock_connection fixture returns a Mock with properly configured
cursor that supports: cursor.return_value.__enter__.return_value pattern

* Fix cursor resource leak in _is_connection_valid

When an exception occurs during cursor.execute() or cursor.fetchone(),
the cursor created earlier is never closed. This leaks database cursor
resources each time connection validation fails.

Fixed by:
- Using try-finally to ensure cursor.close() is always called
- Setting cursor = None initially to safely check in finally block
- Best-effort close pattern (doesn't fail if close fails)

This prevents cursor accumulation in long-running applications where
_is_connection_valid is called frequently to validate connections.

Addresses: https://github.com/514-labs/registry/pull/177#discussion_r2737766521

* Remove unused patch decorators from retry tests

Tests test_insert_with_retry_success_on_first_attempt and
test_insert_with_retry_retries_on_failure had @patch decorators that
injected mock_cdc_module parameters which were never used.

These tests directly create their own mock_table and pass it to
_insert_with_retry, making the module-level patches unnecessary.

Removed:
- @patch("app.ingest.cdc") decorators
- mock_cdc_module parameters from method signatures

This reduces test clutter and prevents confusion about which mocks
are actually relevant to these specific tests.

Addresses: https://github.com/514-labs/registry/pull/177#discussion_r2737766514
